criterion.criterion: Keep the complete axial-point construction: three special rays coincide with the principal axis; trace SB to lens point B using secondary axis PQ through the optical center parallel to SB; intersect it at C with the far focal plane through F; refracted ray BC goes through C. Retain the axial ray as the second ray. With S between near focus and converging lens, the divergent refracted rays' backward extensions locate virtual S_1.

dimensions.complete_source_coverage: Axial degeneracy, SB, B, PQ, focal plane F, C, BC, two-ray construction, object-location condition, virtual S_1 and fig180/caption all have evidence, including the cross-figure 折/射 join.
dimensions.physics_soundness: Secondary axis is parallel to SB and passes through the optical center. F names a focal point defining the transverse focal plane, not the entire plane as a point; C is the plane-axis intersection. Virtual-image extensions are geometric constructions, not actual backward light propagation.
dimensions.ZHEN_correspondence: All notation and construction steps, the plane-versus-point distinction, inside-focus condition and virtual-image mechanism correspond.
dimensions.teaching_enumeration_as_prose: The explanation and worked axial construction remain prose, with no invented questions, distances, scale or measurements.
